intuition: A complete tree is perfect when its leftmost and rightmost heights match; otherwise recurse into its two smaller complete subtrees.

brute_force.approach: Traverse every node and increment a counter.

optimal.approach: Compare leftmost and rightmost heights; count a perfect subtree with 2^height-1, otherwise recurse.

edge_cases: An empty tree has zero nodes.
A perfect subtree can be counted without visiting each node.
The height shortcut relies on the complete-tree guarantee.
